_note: PLACEHOLDER army movement tuning. Every number here is a tunable placeholder, not approved balance. Confirmed (constitution): campaign movement uses a per-turn movement allowance in the Total War style; an army may move several times while its allowance permits. Costs: one movement point per meter of open ground, times the terrain cost of the cell entered (diagonal steps cost their real length). core/movement.gd applies these values; the terrain grid itself is the map's movement grid.

army._note: Movement points per turn, refilled on End Turn. Scaled 2.5x on 2026-10-06 with the maps (owner: the world enlarged 2.5x, marches take about the same number of turns). Agents, envoys and fleets do not exist yet; when they come, their allowances scale the same way.

terrain._note: cost multiplies the distance walked into a cell of that terrain; null = impassable. Mountains are impassable except where a pass crosses them; water is impassable (no naval movement in this block).

marsh._note: Swamp and marsh climates (map pipeline): open or wooded ground there is marsh. Appended last so older bakes stay valid.

roads._note: PLACEHOLDER RULE, not in the constitution: the constitution only confirms that road upgrades change the visible road surface. Here a road cell costs multiplier_by_level[road level] regardless of the terrain under it (dirt 0, gravel 1, stone 2): a dirt road is about 35% faster than open ground (owner, 2026-10-07). Off-road movement is free everywhere passable; the pathfinder takes roads when they are faster. The road network is per map (data/maps/<id>/movement.json, merged over this file) and is also what the map draws.

passes._note: Each map lists its passes (data/maps/<id>/movement.json): corridors through the mountains that stay passable (terrain 'pass').

settlements._note: An army entering this radius around a settlement position (data/maps/<map>/provinces.json) is at that settlement: its own settlement garrisons it; a foreign one would mean battle, which is not implemented.

armies._note: Destinations within this radius of another faction's army would mean battle (not implemented), so they are blocked.

grid_bake._note: Thresholds used only by the grid bake (main.gd --bake-movement-grid) to classify the map's terrain into the map's movement grid. Gameplay reads the baked grid, never the terrain mesh.
